patterns.note: Full-bleed hero image/video with overlaid text, transitioning into a grid-based layout for project showcases, and large, staggered typographic elements that span the width of the page.

Aggressive use of oversized, condensed sans-serif typography for section titles and numbers, creating a bold, almost architectural feel, contrasted with a distinctive blackletter script for specific branding elements.
A stark, high-contrast color palette primarily using a dark blue-grey and a light beige/off-white, with minimal use of other colors, allowing project imagery to provide visual accents.

The hero image/video scales and parallaxes upwards on scroll, revealing a large, layered text headline. Subsequent content sections and large typographic elements (like 'WORK' and section numbers) reveal with staggered fade-in and slide-up animations as they enter the viewport.
Content is organized into distinct, numbered sections (01, 02, 03) corresponding to service categories (Film, Advertising, Television), each introduced by a large, animated number and category title.

technique_notes: The hero section uses a video or large image that scales down and translates upwards, creating a parallax effect, while overlaid text elements animate to reveal the main headline. This likely leverages GSAP for precise timing and easing.

Large, multi-part text elements (like 'WORK' and the section numbers) are revealed with a staggered animation, where individual letters or digits slide or fade into place sequentially as the user scrolls, creating a dynamic typographic reveal. This effect is often achieved with GSAP's ScrollTrigger.
Content blocks and project thumbnails within sections appear with a fade-in and slight upward translation as they scroll into view, enhancing the sense of discovery and visual flow.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, condensed sans-serif headings and numbers create a powerful, editorial impact, contrasting with smaller, legible body text and a distinctive blackletter display font for specific branding.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, especially in the hero and between major sections, with large negative space around key typographic elements and content blocks.

standout: The aggressive, editorial use of oversized, condensed typography that interacts dynamically with scroll, combined with a stark, high-contrast color palette and a distinctive blackletter font, creates a powerful and memorable brand identity that feels both gritty and sophisticated.
